sectionDescription: A curated selection of high-performance architectural solutions and full-stack implementations by Nevin Zachariah John. Focused on REST APIs, microservices, and extreme optimization.

projects.title: Video Processing Platform
projects.description: A scalable backend video processing platform using Node.js to automate media editing workflows. Integrated FFmpeg pipelines for resizing, compression, and format conversion. Implemented asynchronous queue processing for high-performance handling.

projects.title: Real-Time Chat Application
projects.description: Built a scalable real-time group chat application using WebSockets and Redis Pub/Sub, enabling instant messaging across multiple horizontally scaled server instances. Implemented JWT-secured APIs and persistent message storage.
